description.value: Arbutus Distillery is a BC-classified craft distillery in Nanaimo that brews, ferments, distils, and bottles all its spirits on-site using 100% BC-grown fermentables and many botanicals grown on the property. Its award-winning lineup includes Canadian Single Malt Whisky, Canadian Rye Whisky, brandy, absinthe, and gin. Visiting cyclists can sample and purchase bottles directly at the on-site Tasting Lounge, which also offers weekend cocktail service.
